title: Thinking Strategies
content: First Principal Thinking: Break obstacles into smaller, solvable problems. Inversion Thinking: Consider problems from the opposite perspective to identify what to avoid. Frame Works: Organize repetitive tasks into fixed frameworks for easier execution.
raw_text:
How to think clearly or better

First principal thinking.

Break obstacles into smaller once to see which can be solved or make better.

Inversion thinking

Inverse your problems. Like how to live life in mediocrity. It will give u things to avoid. Frame works

Put things which are repetative into a fixed framework. What to do when urge appear. What to do when not feel like speaking etc.
